name: 48060 · Port Huron, MI
findings: ZIP 48060 (Port Huron) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48060 (Port Huron) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
